# ywc-agent-toolkit

> A distribution toolkit published on GitHub. Claude Code: 49 skills and 13 agents. Codex: 51 skills and 10 agents.

## Agents (Codex)

- [ywc-architect](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-architect.toml): Architecture advisor for module boundaries, dependency direction, layering, abstraction trade-offs, API contract shape, and irreversible design decisions.
- [ywc-cloud-engineer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-cloud-engineer.toml): Read-only Infrastructure-as-Code review-mode advisor — the Codex mirror of the read-write cloud engineer worker.
- [ywc-complexity-cleaner](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-complexity-cleaner.toml): Bounded write worker for behavior-preserving complexity reduction in task-owned production code.
- [ywc-go-reviewer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-go-reviewer.toml): Read-only Go reviewer for goroutine lifecycle, channel patterns, interfaces, error wrapping, pointer/value semantics, generics, and lifecycle idioms.
- [ywc-performance-engineer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-performance-engineer.toml): Read-only performance reviewer for backend latency, frontend bundle/render cost, Core Web Vitals, profiler recommendations, and cloud infrastructure cost / FinO…
- [ywc-python-reviewer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-python-reviewer.toml): Read-only Python reviewer for typing, asyncio, framework idioms, GIL implications, lifecycle correctness, and strict tooling baselines.
- [ywc-root-cause-analyst](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-root-cause-analyst.toml): Read-only root-cause analyst for defects, failed tests, incidents, 5 Whys, hypothesis ranking, and architecture-vs-surgical-fix gates.
- [ywc-security-engineer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-security-engineer.toml): Read-only static security reviewer for OWASP Top 10 analysis, bounded threat modeling, secret or PII scans, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) misconfiguration …
- [ywc-test-hardener](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-test-hardener.toml): Bounded write worker for assertion and fixture hardening against task-owned mutation survivors.
- [ywc-typescript-reviewer](https://github.com/yongwoon/ywc-agent-toolkit/blob/main/codex/agents/ywc-typescript-reviewer.toml): Read-only TypeScript and JavaScript reviewer for type-system depth, async correctness, framework idioms, strictness, and module surface risks.
